title: Is it handball? The 3 questions of Law 12

scenes.text: “Handball is handball” isn't a thing. The law asks three questions.
First of all: where did it hit? The arm starts below the armpit. The shoulder is not handball.
Question one: was it deliberate? If you move your hand towards the ball, it's always a foul.
Two: did the arm make the body unnaturally bigger? Then it's a foul, even if you didn't mean it.
Three: do you score right after it touches your hand? Goal disallowed, even if it was accidental.
Three noes? Play on. And inside the box the law is the same: only the punishment changes.
And the goalkeeper? Outside the penalty area, he's just another player.
Save it, and share it with whoever shouts handball at every touch.
